required_binaries.name: python
required_binaries.reason: Runs ocr.py for cloud OCR API calls (Tencent Cloud / Alibaba Cloud)

required_env.name: TENCENTCLOUD_SECRET_ID
required_env.reason: Tencent Cloud API credential (with TENCENTCLOUD_SECRET_KEY); get from https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cam/capi

required_env.name: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID
required_env.reason: Alibaba Cloud API credential (with ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET); get from https://ram.console.aliyun.com/manage/ak
